title: Ideas Inbox and promotion workflow
summary: Add a top-level Ideas Inbox with Web UI CRUD and agent-guided promotion into feature, phase, or task work.
description: Current state: the planner has no Ideas domain, no `/ideas` route, and no Pi/MCP idea tools; `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts` and `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` model only project, requirements, features, phases, and tasks, while `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx` and the app router expose no Ideas navigation. Implement a harness-agnostic top-level Ideas Inbox persisted separately from features/phases/tasks so ideas never participate in status derivation. Add stable human references, CRUD, Web UI route/navigation, and agent promotion workflows for feature, phase, and task targets. Copy the approved user-level `/Users/antonio/.pi/agent/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md` contract into a shipped canonical asset that seeds `.planner/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md` for every extension user; load that project-local skill when an agent discusses or promotes an idea. Preserve core harness independence, existing planner priority/status behavior, mobile header navigation, managed-file customization safety, and isolated temporary planner roots in tests.

acceptedDecisions.title: Ideas are a top-level non-work domain
acceptedDecisions.decision: Persist Ideas in a dedicated top-level inbox outside features, phases, tasks, and requirements; Ideas operations never participate in status derivation, task recommendation, active work, or resume state.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Ideas are intentionally unplanned capture items. Modeling them as planned tasks would distort planner progress and readiness.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Use stable I### references and independent persistence/counter state. Keep promoted ideas as linked history; explicit removal remains a separate user action.

acceptedDecisions.title: Project-local grill-me skill drives idea promotion discussions
acceptedDecisions.decision: Copy the approved user-level grill-me skill into a shipped canonical asset that seeds `.planner/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md` for every project, and load that project-local skill whenever an agent discusses or promotes an idea.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Every extension user and harness must receive the same rigorous clarification protocol without depending on Antonio's user folder or globally installed skills.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Follow managed-skill upgrade safety: timestamp-free canonical bytes, upgrade unmodified copies, preserve customized copies with drift reporting, and do not leak the skill into human recaps or unrelated turns.

acceptedDecisions.title: Idea promotion is discussion-first and target-confirmed
acceptedDecisions.decision: Feature promotion must clarify insufficient content with grill-me before creating the feature and its phases/tasks; phase promotion must recommend and confirm a parent feature before discussion and creation; task promotion must recommend and confirm the parent feature/phase before discussion and creation.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Promotion changes an unplanned idea into governed planner work and must not guess scope or ownership from incomplete text.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Persist promoted state only after the target entities exist and read back successfully. Return composite human refs and retain the idea as promotion history.

tasks.title: Add the harness-agnostic Ideas Inbox domain and persistence
tasks.description:
Implement the top-level Ideas domain in `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, and shared reference/rendering helpers. Persist ideas independently under `.planner/` (for example `.planner/ideas.json`) with stable UUID identity plus monotonic human references such as `I001`, editable title/description, deterministic ordering, timestamps, and promotion metadata linking a promoted idea to its resulting feature/phase/task. CRUD and promotion bookkeeping must never create child containment or affect feature/phase/task status derivation, task recommendation, resume state, or readiness. Decide and document the compatibility/upgrade strategy for the new file and counter, preserve customized project data, and cover initialization, reload, atomic validation, delete, edit, promoted-history retention, and rollup isolation using temporary planner roots only.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the harness-agnostic Ideas Inbox domain in plan-core. Added Idea/IdeasDocument/promotion schemas and exported types; stable UUID plus independent monotonic I### and shortId identity; formatIdeaRef/findIdeaByRef; `.planner/ideas.json` initialization and backward-compatible missing-file reads; cross-worktree allocation support for idea identities; atomic PlanStore create/update/delete/promote operations with target existence validation and retained promotion history; Ideas inclusion in PlanWorkspace and generated PLAN.md; and shared/local boundary documentation. Ideas remain entirely outside feature/phase/task containment, status derivation, work selection, active work, requirements, and resume state. Verification: @agent-plan/core check/build passed; focused 28/28 tests passed; full plan-core suite passed 265/265; git diff --check passed. Added packages/plan-core/test/ideas.test.mjs covering init, reload, monotonic gaps, invalid-update atomicity, refs, feature/phase/task promotion, idempotence/conflicts, generated rendering, and rollup/resume isolation. No commit or push performed after the user-authorized baseline commit.

tasks.title: Expose Ideas CRUD and guided promotion across Pi and MCP
tasks.description:
Add complete cross-harness idea tools and commands in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, the canonical planner skill, and public-surface inventories. Agents must be able to list/show/create/update/delete ideas and begin/finalize promotion. Feature promotion loads `.planner/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md` when the idea lacks sufficient detail, resolves the design with the user, creates the agreed feature plus appropriate phases/tasks, then records the resulting feature reference. Phase promotion must inspect and recommend the most appropriate feature, obtain user confirmation, run the grill-me discussion, create the phase/tasks, and record the phase reference. Task promotion must recommend and confirm the feature/phase, run the discussion, create the task, and record its reference. Keep promotion multi-step and confirmation-safe: no target entity or promoted state may be persisted before the discussion and target confirmation complete. Return composite human refs, never raw UUIDs, and maintain Pi/MCP contract parity with real transport tests.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented complete cross-harness Ideas CRUD and confirmation-safe guided promotion surfaces. Pi now exposes idea_list/show/create/update/delete/promotion_begin/promotion_finalize tools plus `/planner idea list|add|show|update|delete|promote`; MCP exposes matching planner-idea-* tools. Promotion begin demand-loads the managed project-local grill-me skill, returns target guidance and never writes. The agent interviews one question at a time, recommends and confirms feature/phase placement, creates the agreed target through normal validated creation tools only after explicit confirmation, and finalization records promotion history only when discussionCompleted=true, confirmed=true, and the target resolves; composite refs are returned. Added canonical skill command/inventory guidance, public surface entries, Pi registration coverage, Pi confirmation/no-write regression, and real stdio MCP transport regression. Verification: pnpm build and pnpm check passed; focused Pi/MCP tests passed 59/59; full pnpm test:coverage passed 513/513 Node and 84/84 Web UI tests with final coverage 86.16% lines, 74.01% branches, 81.22% functions; plugins:check and git diff --check passed. No commit or push after the previously authorized checkpoint.

tasks.title: Verify Ideas promotion end to end without planner rollup side effects

Prove that idea creation/edit/removal/promotion never changes feature/phase/task derived statuses, task recommendation, active work, resume state, counters other than the Ideas counter, or linked requirements.
